title: Watch: L.B. Foster Threaded Products Facility in Magnolia, TX
summary: Our Threaded Products facility is located in Magnolia, Texas and provides threading services for agricultural, municipal, and industrial waterwell applications.
body_markdown: Watch how L.B. Foster's innovative plant uses advanced technology[threading](https://lbfoster.com/infrastructure/waterwell-threaded-products) equipment to meet precise customer specifications and expedite deliveries nationwide. Our facility was designed from the ground up to incorporate equipment in a single flow manufacturing line.
